#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf titled 'Annual Financial Report' with the current date.

Only operates on the report.pdf named by argv (default: report.pdf). Builds the
cover in memory with reportlab, prepends it to the existing pages with pypdf,
atomically replaces report.pdf, and validates the result by reading it back.
"""
import datetime
import io
import os
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas


def main() -> int:
    target = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "report.pdf"
    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    if not os.path.isfile(target):
        print(f"ERROR: {target!r} not found in {os.getcwd()}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    # --- Build the cover page in memory (single page, no external effects) ---
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter

    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    title_w = c.stringWidth(title, "Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawString((width - title_w) / 2.0, height - 330.0, title)

    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    date_w = c.stringWidth(date_str, "Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawString((width - date_w) / 2.0, height - 370.0, date_str)

    c.showPage()
    c.save()
    buf.seek(0)
    cover_page = PdfReader(buf).pages[0]

    # --- Prepend the cover to the existing report.pdf pages ---
    src = PdfReader(target)
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_page)
    for page in src.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    tmp = target + ".cover_tmp.pdf"
    with open(tmp, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)
    os.replace(tmp, target)

    # --- Validate: read back the transformed report.pdf ---
    check = PdfReader(target)
    first_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    ok_title = title in first_text
    ok_date = date_str in first_text
    print(f"pages_after: {len(check.pages)}")
    print(f"title_present: {ok_title}")
    print(f"date_present: {ok_date} (date used: {date_str})")
    print("first_page_text:", repr(first_text[:300]))
    return 0 if (ok_title and ok_date and len(check.pages) >= 2) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Task helper: prepend a cover page to report.pdf.

The cover page contains the exact title 'Annual Financial Report' and the
current date (operator runtime local date). The script only reads report.pdf
and rewrites report.pdf with the cover page prepended; all intermediate work
happens in memory. A self-check validates the result at the end of the run.
"""
import datetime
import io
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

PDF_PATH = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

# 1. Read the original report fully into memory.
with open(PDF_PATH, "rb") as fh:
    source_bytes = fh.read()
reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(source_bytes))
original_page_count = len(reader.pages)
if original_page_count == 0:
    raise SystemExit("report.pdf has no pages; nothing to prepend a cover to")

# Match the cover page size to the report's first page.
first_box = reader.pages[0].mediabox
page_w = float(first_box.width)
page_h = float(first_box.height)

# 2. Render the cover page with reportlab into an in-memory buffer.
today = datetime.date.today()
today_label = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
cover_buf = io.BytesIO()
cover_canvas = canvas.Canvas(cover_buf, pagesize=(page_w, page_h))
cover_canvas.setTitle(TITLE)
title_size = 30 if page_w >= 500 else 20
date_size = 16 if page_w >= 500 else 12
cover_canvas.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", title_size)
cover_canvas.drawCentredString(page_w / 2.0, page_h * 0.64, TITLE)
cover_canvas.setFont("Helvetica", date_size)
cover_canvas.drawCentredString(page_w / 2.0, page_h * 0.64 - 44, today_label)
cover_canvas.showPage()
cover_canvas.save()
cover_buf.seek(0)

# 3. Prepend the cover page to the original report and write back in place.
writer = PdfWriter()
cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_buf)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

out_buf = io.BytesIO()
writer.write(out_buf)
with open(PDF_PATH, "wb") as fh:
    fh.write(out_buf.getvalue())

# 4. Validate the result.
check = PdfReader(PDF_PATH)
if len(check.pages) != original_page_count + 1:
    raise SystemExit(
        "FAIL: expected %d pages, found %d" % (original_page_count + 1, len(check.pages))
    )
first_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
if TITLE not in first_text:
    raise SystemExit("FAIL: cover title missing from first page text: %r" % first_text)
if today_label not in first_text:
    raise SystemExit("FAIL: current date missing from first page text: %r" % first_text)

print("PAGES_BEFORE=%d" % original_page_count)
print("PAGES_AFTER=%d" % len(check.pages))
print("DATE_LABEL=%s" % today_label)
print("COVER_TEXT=%r" % first_text.strip())
print("OK: cover page with title %r and date %s added to %s" % (TITLE, today_label, PDF_PATH))

"""
import datetime
import io
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

PDF_PATH = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def _esc_literal(text):
    """Escape a PDF literal string (parentheses and backslashes)."""
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def _text_width(text, size, bold=False):
    """Rough Helvetica width estimate (in points) for centering the text."""
    # Widths in 1/1000 em units (approximate base-14 Helvetica metrics).
    units = 0
    for ch in text:
        if ch == " ":
            units += 278
        elif ch.isupper() or ch.isdigit():
            units += 667 if bold else 556
        elif ch in ",.;:":
            units += 278
        elif ch in "!|Ilj":
            units += 278
        else:
            units += 500
    return units / 1000.0 * size


def _fmt_num(value):
    text = "%.2f" % value
    if text.endswith(".00"):
        text = text[:-3]
    return text


def make_cover_pdf_bytes(width, height, title, date_text):
    """Build a minimal valid single-page PDF containing the cover text.

    Only the PDF text operators are used with the base-14 Helvetica fonts, so
    no font embedding or third-party libraries are required.
    """
    title_size = 32 if width >= 500 else 20
    date_size = 18 if width >= 500 else 12

    title_y = height * 0.66
    date_y = title_y - title_size - 26

    title_x = (width - _text_width(title, title_size, bold=True)) / 2.0
    date_x = (width - _text_width(date_text, date_size, bold=False)) / 2.0

    content = (
        "BT\n"
        "1 0 0 1 {tx:.2f} {ty:.2f} Tm\n"
        "/F1 {ts} Tf\n"
        "({title}) Tj\n"
        "1 0 0 1 {dx:.2f} {dy:.2f} Tm\n"
        "/F2 {ds} Tf\n"
        "({date}) Tj\n"
        "ET"
    ).format(
        tx=title_x, ty=title_y, ts=title_size, title=_esc_literal(title),
        dx=date_x, dy=date_y, ds=date_size, date=_esc_literal(date_text),
    ).encode("latin-1")

    w = _fmt_num(width)
    h = _fmt_num(height)

    objects = [
        # 1: catalog
        "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        # 2: page tree
        "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        # 3: cover page
        ("<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 %s %s] "
         "/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> "
         "/Contents 6 0 R >>") % (w, h),
        # 4: title font (Helvetica-Bold)
        "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        # 5: date font (Helvetica)
        "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        # 6: content stream
        "<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n%s\nendstream" % (len(content), content.decode("latin-1")),
    ]

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for index, body in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out.extend(("%d 0 obj\n" % index).encode("latin-1"))
        out.extend(body.encode("latin-1"))
        out.extend(b"\nendobj\n")

    xref_pos = len(out)
    obj_count = len(objects) + 1
    out.extend(("xref\n0 %d\n" % obj_count).encode("latin-1"))
    out.extend(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")
    for off in offsets:
        out.extend(("%010d 00000 n \n" % off).encode("latin-1"))
    out.extend(
        ("trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
         % (obj_count, xref_pos)).encode("latin-1")
    )
    return bytes(out)


# 1. Read the original report fully into memory.
with open(PDF_PATH, "rb") as fh:
    source_bytes = fh.read()
reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(source_bytes))
original_page_count = len(reader.pages)
if original_page_count == 0:
    raise SystemExit("report.pdf has no pages; nothing to prepend a cover to")

# Match the cover page size to the report's first page.
first_box = reader.pages[0].mediabox
page_w = float(first_box.width)
page_h = float(first_box.height)

# 2. Build the cover page (in memory) with the title and current date.
today = datetime.date.today()
today_label = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
cover_bytes = make_cover_pdf_bytes(page_w, page_h, TITLE, today_label)

# 3. Prepend the cover page to the original report and write back in place.
writer = PdfWriter()
cover_reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(cover_bytes))
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

out_buf = io.BytesIO()
writer.write(out_buf)
with open(PDF_PATH, "wb") as fh:
    fh.write(out_buf.getvalue())

# 4. Validate the result.
check = PdfReader(PDF_PATH)
if len(check.pages) != original_page_count + 1:
    raise SystemExit(
        "FAIL: expected %d pages, found %d" % (original_page_count + 1, len(check.pages))
    )
first_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
if TITLE not in first_text:
    raise SystemExit("FAIL: cover title missing from first page text: %r" % first_text)
if today_label not in first_text:
    raise SystemExit("FAIL: current date missing from first page text: %r" % first_text)

print("PAGES_BEFORE=%d" % original_page_count)
print("PAGES_AFTER=%d" % len(check.pages))
print("DATE_LABEL=%s" % today_label)
print("COVER_TEXT=%r" % first_text.strip())
print("OK: cover page with title %r and date %s added to %s" % (TITLE, today_label, PDF_PATH))

"""Read-only validation of report.pdf after the cover-page transformation.

Checks that page 1 is a cover page containing the exact title
'Annual Financial Report' and the current date, and that the previously
existing pages still follow (report.pdf has more than one page with text).
Does not modify report.pdf or any other file.
"""
import datetime
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader

PDF_PATH = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
today_label = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

reader = PdfReader(PDF_PATH)
print("TOTAL_PAGES=%d" % len(reader.pages))
for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages, start=1):
    text = (page.extract_text() or "").strip()
    snippet = text.replace("\n", " | ")[:200]
    print("PAGE %d TEXT=%s" % (i, snippet))

first_text = (reader.pages[0].extract_text() or "").replace("\n", " ")
assert TITLE in first_text, "cover title not found on page 1"
assert today_label in first_text, "current date not found on page 1"
assert len(reader.pages) >= 2, "expected the original report pages to follow the cover"
for i in range(1, len(reader.pages)):
    assert (reader.pages[i].extract_text() or "").strip(), (
        "page %d unexpectedly has no text" % (i + 1)
    )
print("VALIDATION_OK: page 1 is the cover (%r / %s); %d original pages follow"
      % (TITLE, today_label, len(reader.pages) - 1))
